treatment: Portrait 4:5 unoccupied reality-TV environments with the existing cast on independent layers. Separately generated transparent door and luggage cutouts.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: empty environment backplate for a premium reality-TV mobile game, portrait 4:5 framing.
Create a sophisticated, believable sequester penthouse window wall at night. A broad floor-to-ceiling picture window reveals a richly detailed real metropolis far below: layered towers, varied warm office lights, a few elegant architectural silhouettes, atmospheric distance, subtle street-light ribbons. It must feel like a prestige reality television residence, not a generic game illustration.
Interior: restrained smoked walnut side reveals, slim brushed champagne-bronze window frames, warm stone sill, two understated vertical wall lights, softly draped dark taupe curtains at the extreme sides. Expensive tactile materials, controlled cinematic exposure, convincing glass and faint interior reflections. A quiet dark limestone floor fills the lower quarter, clearly level and uncluttered.
Camera: straight-on at standing eye level, minimal wide-angle distortion. The visible floor begins around 76 percent down the frame. Leave the center and both side thirds completely clear for three separately composited full-body contestants standing in front of the window. Lighting in the room is soft neutral-warm frontal fill, compatible with realistic existing character cutouts. Keep the city visible around their heads and shoulders.
Style: beautifully art-directed architectural photography / high-end television production still, subtle plum shadows and champagne highlights. Rich realism and depth, no ostentation. Strong composition readable on a narrow portrait phone.
Constraints: EMPTY room. No people, figures, silhouettes, furniture, chairs, tables, lettering, signs, logos, UI, borders, watermarks, doors, neon, magic, particles or light-beam effects. No flat vector city, simplified rectangular skyline, tiled-looking windows, cartoon render, fisheye, glowing portal or shiny plastic. One coherent complete backplate, no separated panels or contact sheet.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: empty portrait 4:5 environment backplate for a premium reality-TV mobile game farewell.
Scene: a beautifully designed contemporary television-house departure vestibule at night. Dark smoked-walnut wall panels, precise champagne-brass reveals, muted warm stone and cinematic practical lighting. On the RIGHT half is one tall open double-door exit, viewed straight on, leading OUTWARD to a covered, warmly lit arrival/departure walkway. Beyond that walkway are tasteful distant city lights, a few soft landscaping shapes and a believable exterior ground plane. This is leaving the residence, not entering a lounge or stepping off a high-rise ledge.
Composition contract: portrait 4:5. The doorway opening occupies approximately x=48% to x=88%, y=12% to y=75%. A refined rectangular walnut-and-brass frame surrounds it. No door leaves: the opening is completely unobstructed, because separate door cutouts will close across it later. Level dark stone foreground floor begins around 75% down. The LEFT third is clear for a separately composited standing departing contestant, with space beside their feet for a separately composited suitcase. A soft neutral-warm frontal key light will suit realistic character assets.
Art direction: a prestige reality television finale departure shot, sophisticated architectural photography, tactile real materials, restrained polished detail, deep but readable plum/charcoal shadows, warm champagne light, composed and quiet. The exterior opening should suggest a real route home. Narrow portrait phone readability.
Constraints: empty set. No people, bodies, silhouettes, suitcases, furniture, captions, lettering, EXIT text, logos, UI or watermark. No neon, particles, magic portal, dramatic beams, ornate palace decor, flat vector shapes or plastic game render. One complete coherent backplate. Preserve a flat frontal door plane suitable for separately composited door leaves.

Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: ONE transparent architectural door-leaf cutout for a layered mobile-game farewell.
Input image 1 is MATERIAL AND LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY; do not reproduce the room or doorway.
Create a single tall narrow solid smoked-walnut door leaf, seen perfectly straight-on, suitable for half of the pictured double-door opening. Very refined flat walnut joinery, subtle real grain matching the reference, thin champagne-bronze perimeter detailing, understated long vertical bronze pull near the RIGHT edge. Quiet luxury reality-TV house architecture, realistic physical materials and soft frontal warm studio light. Rectangular silhouette, portrait approximately 1:3 proportions, full door visible with a small transparent margin. No perspective skew and no scene lighting shadow outside the object.
Only the one door leaf. Genuine transparent background. No doorframe, wall, floor, city, person, text, logo, decor, panel grid, props, flat vector style, plastic, glow or cast ground shadow. Its matching right-hand leaf will be made by mirroring this asset in code.

Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: ONE genuinely transparent luggage prop cutout for a premium reality-TV mobile-game departure.
A refined medium carry-on suitcase standing upright on its small wheels, seen nearly straight on with a subtle three-quarter angle. Rich charcoal pebble-grain leather or fine textile shell, realistic restrained champagne-metal hardware, short top handle and a neat extended telescopic handle. Tasteful unbranded craftsmanship, elegantly understated rather than ostentatious. Physically believable proportions, photographic materials, soft neutral-warm frontal key light compatible with realistic full-body contestant cutouts. Entire suitcase and handle fully visible, small transparent margin, portrait framing. Ground contact is at the lowest wheel pixels.
Isolated object with real alpha transparency. No person, hands, body, room, floor, rectangular background, logo, lettering, watermark, particles, glows, neon, extra bags or cast ground shadow. Not an icon, not a cartoon, not a flat illustration.
assets.cleanupPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve this exact suitcase, its shape, materials, hardware, wheels, lighting, framing and extended handle.
Remove EVERY trace of the smoky grey/black backdrop and halo around it. Make the entire area outside the physical suitcase genuinely fully transparent, including the opening inside the telescopic handle and the spaces between wheels. Preserve clean soft antialiased object edges without a white/grey border. No cast shadow or reflection outside the suitcase. Keep only the suitcase itself. Do not redesign, recolour, crop off or add anything. Output a proper transparent cutout.
